title: Explainable still-to-motion composition
intent: Turn arbitrary suitable still images into reproducible motion with explicit camera, layers, masks, and reviewable constraints.
applicability: At least one readable still image is available
Source resolution supports the requested crop and scale
contraindications: Independent generated object motion is essential
A true depth reconstruction is required
rules: Compile effects through the ordinary renderer
heuristics: Increase motion amplitude toward foreground layers
Use restrained motion unless intent requests energy
Cap scale by available source detail
constraints: Every curve begins and ends inside the clip
Generated or licensed sound requires separate provenance
qc: Review first, middle, and final frames
positive_examples: A high-resolution illustration animated with shallow parallax
A photograph given a restrained push and title
negative_examples: A low-resolution icon subjected to an extreme close-up
A portrait whose face and background require semantic reconstruction
promotion_questions: Which source-resolution guard best predicts safe maximum scale?
When should semantic depth replace the deterministic proxy?
How should alpha-capable delivery profiles be represented?
